t: What Hydrogen Fuel Cell Trucks Is
title: What Hydrogen Fuel Cell Trucks Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Hydrogen fuel-cell trucks haul freight with electric drivetrains powered by hydrogen: 500+ mile range, 15-minute refueling, zero tailpipe emissions — decarbonizing the long-haul trucking that batteries struggle to serve. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Hydrogen Fuel Cell Trucks: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.

Why it matters: Long-haul trucking needs range and fast refuel; fuel cells deliver both, cleanly..
Where it is used: long-haul freight, drayage, refuse, regional haul..
